For page numbers 1 through 999, the number of digit triples (allowing leading zeros) that sum to 4 is  
\[
\binom{4+3-1}{3-1}=\binom{6}{2}=15.
\]
Page 1000 has digit sum \(1+0+0+0=1\), so it is not counted.

The answer is 15.
